disclaimer: sourceText is quoted or lightly trimmed from public ClinicalTrials.gov eligibility language, or is a short age phrase from that text. Attribute those records to ClinicalTrials.gov. These labels were written before any parser call on this held-out set.

excludedFromThisSet.consideredThenDroppedNotes: NCT07293247 requires M0 (no metastatic disease). NCT05142189 has cohort-dependent ECOG and stage rules. NCT05967689 is a multi-cohort EGFR study with conflicting arm-specific ECOG and prior-therapy rules and a garbled ECOG line. NCT06069570 enrolls NSCLC or other solid tumors with bone metastases. NCT07357597 enrolls breast cancer and EGFRm NSCLC cohorts. None of these five were labeled or used to tune the parser.

labelingNotes: Twenty-five recruiting regional NSCLC trials from data/ctgov/region-trials.json with advanced or stage III/IV language. None are in the original gold set, the three few-shots, the few-shot inspection list, held-out set 1, or held-out set 2.
Labels cover key typed criteria only, with emphasis on the six key types: driver mutation or variant, stage, prior therapy lines or classes, ECOG, brain mets, and key lab thresholds.

Compound, cohort-dependent, or unless/exception rules were not forced into a typed kind (for example part-dependent stage lists, geography-dependent age floors, histology-dependent driver rules, Gilbert's or liver-mets lab exceptions, and brain-mets bullets that allow treated or inactive lesions).

Stage lists use explicit stage tokens when they appear. 'Stage IV' or 'Stage 4' is labeled IV, IVA, and IVB. 'Stage IIIB-IIIC or Stage IV' and 'Stage IIIB or IIIC ... or Stage IV' are labeled IIIB, IIIC, IV, IVA, and IVB. Unresectable Stage III is labeled IIIA, IIIB, and IIIC. 'Stage IIB or III' is labeled IIB, IIIA, IIIB, and IIIC. 'Locally advanced or metastatic' without explicit tokens, and 'Stage IV or recurrent', were not forced into a stage list.

Zubrod performance status was not labeled as ECOG. WHO performance status was not labeled as ECOG. 'Hemoglobin < 9.0 g/dL' on NCT05642572 was not labeled, because the printed inequality is not a usable minimum.
These labels will not be changed after the parser is run, and postprocess or normalizer rules will not be tuned on this set.
